environment: Existing WSL Python environment, fresh temporary source copy
checks: Researcher and auditor have separate model inputs and run IDs under one task ID
Auditor sees frozen host observations before receiving the research claim
Audit tools cannot edit, train or read arbitrary filesystem paths
Submission is parsed as data, never dispatched as a business action
Failed provider attempts remain reserved across resume
Completed checkpoints are idempotent and reject changed scope or evidence
Ambiguous tool mutation requires reconciliation without automatic replay
Rejected or invalid audit cannot pass diagnostic grading or retain a research candidate
Audit rejection is visible in user reports
README and documentation have no broken local links
Frozen diagnostic and coding manifests remain byte-identical to HEAD
retrieval_protocol: research_audit_v1; updated role document and hashes only; historical retrieval scores do not describe this corpus
limitations: Offline scripted models verify contracts and isolation, not real-model audit accuracy
Auditor checks captured observations and cannot independently inspect omitted artifacts
Context and tool capability isolation share one host process
No claim of improvement over a single agent or of complete prompt-injection resistance
